data.summary:
As your Shooting phase or the Fight phase begins, you may Empower this unit by spending 1 Pain token. While Empowered, it gains a benefit for each model type it contains:

- 1 or more Lhamaean models: its models' melee weapons have **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**.
- 1 or more Medusae models: its models' ranged weapons have **[[IGNORES COVER]](vsdata:weapon-ability/ignores-cover)**.
- 1 or more Sslyth models: melee attacks that target it get -1 to the **Wound roll**.
- 1 or more Ur-ghul models: it has **[Fights First](vsdata:core-ability/fights-first)**.
